; Firmware adapter for 3.27.3.0 (also accepts the supplied spelling 3.27.30).
; See docs/compatibility.md. No proprietary QML is distributed.

VERSION 3.27.3.0
VERSION 3.27.30

; Persist the toggle on the notebook toolbar, shared by both menu layouts.
AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    IMPORT Qt.labs.settings 1.0 RmWordCountPrefs
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property alias rmWordCountEnabled: rmWordCountSettings.counterEnabled
            RmWordCountPrefs.Settings {
                id: rmWordCountSettings
                fileName: "/home/root/.config/rm-wordcount.conf"
                category: "WordCount"
                property bool counterEnabled: false
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Notebook settings/context menu.
AFFECT [[11704595946725378272]]
    TRAVERSE [[454089850271038938]]#[[6504254477]] > [[254480451320573660]]#[[16710723433319324941]] > [[14125623155555875541]]#[[233724020048228]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&425121728314878811&~.~&432643201877711221&~ {
                ~&214632764553&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled ? "Hide word count" : "Show word count"
                ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled = !~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled;
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&15738511857451076348&~();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The compact/landscape More Tools menu.
AFFECT [[6025599999262907645]]
    TRAVERSE [[454089850271038938]]#[[6504254477]] > [[14125623155555875541]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&425121728314878811&~.~&432643201877711221&~ {
                ~&214632764553&~: ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled ? "Hide word count" : "Show word count"
                ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled = !~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled;
                    ~&6504254477&~.~&233745975898428&~.~&15738511857451076348&~();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Screen-space overlay: doesn't scroll/zoom with the page or take input.
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: rmWordCountLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 10
                active: ~&233745975898428&~.rmWordCountEnabled
                source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/rm-wordcount/Counter.qml"
                property string rmDocumentId: {
                    var doc = ~&254547437090201330&~.~&7712934851008712&~;
                    return doc ? doc.~&5972374&~ : "";
                }
                property string rmPageId: {
                    var doc = ~&254547437090201330&~.~&7712934851008712&~;
                    var index = ~&254547437090201330&~.~&6504167078&~;
                    return doc && index >= 0 ? doc.~&254533375641282938&~(index) : "";
                }
                onLoaded: {
                    item.documentId = Qt.binding(function() { return rmWordCountLoader.rmDocumentId; });
                    item.pageId = Qt.binding(function() { return rmWordCountLoader.rmPageId; });
                    item.countingEnabled = true;
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
